# Complaint for return of a repair deposit

⟦PERSON|Søren McAven⟧, Plaintiff

v.

⟦ORG|Alder Kite Repairs LLC⟧, Defendant

Docket No.: ⟦CASE|1:26-cv-04731-QL⟧

The plaintiff seeks return of a USD 640 deposit paid for repair of a display mechanism. The defendant accepted the deposit and later confirmed that the necessary replacement part was unavailable. The plaintiff declined an offer to install a component with a lower load rating because it did not meet the specification in the written estimate.

The plaintiff's mailing address is ⟦ADDRESS|Apt 4B, 57 Larchhaven Street, Portland, ME 04102-7634⟧.

The defendant has retained the deposit without identifying work for which a charge is claimed. The plaintiff offered to collect the unrepaired mechanism and asked for an itemised account if any deduction was proposed. No itemised account was supplied before this complaint was prepared.

The amount sought excludes travel expenses and the cost of a later repair by another supplier. The plaintiff requests the deposit, the filing fee and any relief supported by the evidence. The plaintiff relies on Rule 8 and section 4.1 of the exhibit schedule.

Signed: ⟦PERSON|Søren McAven⟧, 27 December 2026.
